'''Water gliders''' were [[Color/Legends|red]], ten-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] that skimmed quickly on the [[Water/Legends|water's]] surface on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. They possessed sharp mandibles, but would flee from sudden movements.
